basics.description: Build a **Linux golden image** with the CrowdStrike Falcon sensor pre-installed (Azure Image Builder + Compute Gallery). Provide your Falcon **API Client ID/Secret** and the **source image** to build from. Secrets are stored in a Key Vault created by the deployment. The sensor is installed with PREP_GOLDEN_IMAGE so the AID is stripped for cloning.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Region for the gallery, image, Key Vault, and Image Builder template.

basics.name: falconClientId
basics.label: CrowdStrike API Client ID
basics.toolTip: Falcon OAuth2 API client id. The client needs Sensor Download (read) and Sensor Update Policies (read) scopes.

validations.message: Client ID is a 32-character hexadecimal string.

basics.name: falconClientSecret
basics.toolTip: Falcon OAuth2 API client secret. Stored as a secret in the Key Vault created by this deployment.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the API client secret (letters and numbers, 32+ characters).

basics.name: sensorUpdatePolicyName
basics.label: Sensor Update Policy name (optional)
basics.toolTip: Optional Linux Sensor Update Policy that determines the sensor version. Leave empty to install the latest available version.

validations.message: Enter a sensor update policy name (or leave empty).

options.text: The base Linux image the golden image is built from. It must be a Gen2 / Trusted Launch capable SKU (typically ends in -gen2). Defaults target Ubuntu Server 22.04 LTS (Gen2).

elements.name: sourceImageSku
elements.label: SKU
elements.toolTip: Marketplace image SKU. Must be Gen2 / Trusted Launch capable (typically ends in -gen2), e.g. 22_04-lts-gen2.

elements.name: sourceImageVersion
elements.label: Version
elements.toolTip: Source image version, e.g. latest or an exact version.

elements.name: imageDefinitionName
elements.label: Image definition name
elements.toolTip: Name for the gallery image definition. Pass the same value to Step 2. Rename to match your distro/version.

validations.message: Enter an image definition name (no spaces).
